description: A sheet whose name holds a rightwards double arrow (U+21D2) last and inside, referenced unquoted in the stored formula, as desktop Excel wrote such names in corpus files (Taskei P561217587, P561218761, P561219993): does Excel for the web load the workbook and read each B1, and what does FORMULATEXT show. A refusal of the workbook is the answer (as for an unquoted Ⓐ, references.md T-4446); one class a case, so a refusal decides only its class. Sheet k holds 10*k in B1. Ours: every unquoted reference is a parse error (#ERROR!), and FORMULATEXT shows the text as stored, unquoted. Inputs are synthetic: no name is a corpus file's.
